thread:
Ellen (partnerships): Quick thread: want to lock the SI co-sell claim cadence, account mapping rules, and how marketplace private offers map to HW bundles. Keep it short, pls.
Raj (sales): Key from sales: who owns outreach, when does AE get the lead if SI is quiet, and how do we credit the AE for marketplace-origin deals.
Hannah (solutions): Proposal: SI gets a 72-hour soft-claim to run discovery. If they set the exclusive_demo flag, they get an additional 72-hour exclusive window. Exclusive means no AE outreach unless escalation is triggered.
Vik (marketplace): For private marketplace offers we need a marketplace_offer_id and a hw_bundle_id on the intake so billing can reconcile. Suggest a single canonical mapping table in Confluence.
Pri (legal): We'll need a short Partner Announcement Addendum and a process: partner drafts -> partnerships approves -> legal review (3 business days) -> signoff. Also IP logo usage must be explicit.
Ellen (partnerships): Minimal intake fields to add: partner_tag, exclusive_demo, marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_id, claim_expires_at. Example callback payload below:
```json
{
  "lead_id": "L-2024-7744",
  "account_id": "SF-9988",
  "partner_tag": "si-zenith",
  "exclusive_demo": true,
  "marketplace_offer_id": "gcp-private-5501",
  "hw_bundle_id": "intel-aero-stack-v2",
  "claim_expires_at": "2024-06-05T15:00:00Z"
}
```
Hannah (solutions): Conflict resolution rules: if two claims overlap, priority = (exclusive_demo true) > (earlier claim_ts) > (partner_tier). Notify both owners + partnerships Slack channel automatically.
Raj (sales): For attribution: marketplace-origin deals get an attribution tag in SFDC, but credit goes to assigned AE unless AE explicitly relinquishes ownership. We'll make attribution_field: marketplace_originated_by.
Vik (marketplace): We'll add export fields marketplace_offer_id and hw_bundle_id. ETA export update: 3 business days.
infra-bot: Note: intake API will accept new optional fields. Schema PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/432
Pri (legal): Also note: any customer-facing joint materials must be archived in the partnership folder and retention set to 2 years for audit.
Ellen (partnerships): Action items: Hannah draft claim & conflict rules doc; Raj propose SFDC attribution field name and process; Vik update marketplace export; Pri prepare announcement addendum. I'll stitch into a one-page playbook and run 20-min review tomorrow 9am PT.
Raj (sales): 9am PT works. Quick ask: can we add auto-escalation for deals > $400k to Sales Ops + Partnerships?
Hannah (solutions): Addable. We'll make escalation threshold configurable in the playbook.
Ellen (partnerships): Great. I'll post playbook link before the review. Thanks all :)
